SELECT pid,
                           EXTRACT($3 FROM (
                               clock_timestamp() - COALESCE(xact_start, query_start)
                           )) * $4
                               AS duration_ms,
                           EXTRACT($5 FROM (clock_timestamp() - xact_start)) * $6
                               AS transaction_duration_ms,
                           state, wait_event_type, wait_event, application_name,
                           pg_blocking_pids(pid) AS blocking_pids,
                           query
                    FROM pg_stat_activity
                    WHERE datname = current_database()
                      AND pid <> pg_backend_pid()
                      AND (
                          (state = $7 AND query_start IS NOT NULL
                           AND clock_timestamp() - query_start
                               >= ($1 * interval $8))
                          OR wait_event_type = $9
                          OR cardinality(pg_blocking_pids(pid)) > $10
                          OR (state = $11 AND xact_start IS NOT NULL
                              AND clock_timestamp() - xact_start
                                  >= ($2 * interval $12))
                      )
                    ORDER BY COALESCE(xact_start, query_start)

WHERE price_bars.ticker IN ($1 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.timeframe = $2::VARCHAR GROUP BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.what_to_show

SELECT price_bars.id, price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date, price_bars.timeframe, price_bars.open, price_bars.high, price_bars.low, price_bars.close, price_bars.volume, price_bars.source, price_bars.what_to_show, price_bars.adjustment_type, price_bars.created_at, price_bars.first_seen_at, price_bars.last_seen_at, price_bars.revised_at, price_bars.revision_count, price_bars.data_hash 
FROM price_bars JOIN (SELECT price_bars.id AS price_bar_id, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY price_bars.ticker ORDER BY price_bars.bar_date DESC) AS date_rank, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN (price_bars.what_to_show = $1::VARCHAR) THEN $2::INTEGER WHEN (price_bars.what_to_show = $3::VARCHAR) THEN $4::INTEGER ELSE $5::INTEGER END, price_bars.id DESC) AS source_rank 
FROM price_bars 
WHERE price_bars.ticker IN ($6 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.timeframe IN ($7 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.what_to_show IN ($8 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.bar_date <= $9::DATE AND price_bars.close IS NOT NULL) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.price_bar_id = price_bars.id 
WHERE anon_1.date_rank <= $10::INTEGER AND anon_1.source_rank = $11::INTEGER ORDER BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date, price_bars.id

SELECT price_bars.id, price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date, price_bars.timeframe, price_bars.open, price_bars.high, price_bars.low, price_bars.close, price_bars.volume, price_bars.source, price_bars.what_to_show, price_bars.adjustment_type, price_bars.created_at, price_bars.first_seen_at, price_bars.last_seen_at, price_bars.revised_at, price_bars.revision_count, price_bars.data_hash 
FROM price_bars JOIN (SELECT price_bars.id AS price_bar_id, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY price_bars.ticker ORDER BY price_bars.bar_date DESC) AS date_rank, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN (price_bars.what_to_show = $1::VARCHAR) THEN $2::INTEGER WHEN (price_bars.what_to_show = $3::VARCHAR) THEN $4::INTEGER ELSE $5::INTEGER END, price_bars.id DESC) AS source_rank 
FROM price_bars 
WHERE price_bars.ticker IN ($6 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.timeframe IN ($7 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.what_to_show IN ($8 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.bar_date <= $9::DATE AND price_bars.close IS NOT NULL) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.price_bar_id = price_bars.id 
WHERE anon_1.date_rank <= $10::INTEGER AND anon_1.source_rank = $11::INTEGER ORDER BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date, price_bars.id

SELECT price_bars.ticker, price_bars.what_to_show, count(price_bars.id) AS count_1, min(price_bars.bar_date) AS min_1, max(price_bars.bar_date) AS max_1 
FROM price_bars 
WHERE price_bars.ticker IN ($1 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.timeframe = $2::VARCHAR GROUP BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.what_to_show

SELECT raw_company_rows.id, raw_company_rows.run_id, raw_company_rows.row_number, raw_company_rows.ticker, raw_company_rows.company_name, raw_company_rows.sector, raw_company_rows.sector_canonical, raw_company_rows.sector_taxonomy, raw_company_rows.sector_mapping_status, raw_company_rows.upcoming_earnings_date, raw_company_rows.raw_json, raw_company_rows.created_at 
FROM raw_company_rows 
WHERE raw_company_rows.run_id = $1::BIGINT ORDER BY raw_company_rows.row_number

SELECT price_bars.id, price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date, price_bars.timeframe, price_bars.open, price_bars.high, price_bars.low, price_bars.close, price_bars.volume, price_bars.source, price_bars.what_to_show, price_bars.adjustment_type, price_bars.created_at, price_bars.first_seen_at, price_bars.last_seen_at, price_bars.revised_at, price_bars.revision_count, price_bars.data_hash 
FROM price_bars JOIN (SELECT price_bars.id AS price_bar_id, dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY price_bars.ticker ORDER BY price_bars.bar_date DESC) AS date_rank, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date ORDER BY CASE WHEN (price_bars.what_to_show = $1::VARCHAR) THEN $2::INTEGER WHEN (price_bars.what_to_show = $3::VARCHAR) THEN $4::INTEGER ELSE $5::INTEGER END, price_bars.id DESC) AS source_rank 
FROM price_bars 
WHERE price_bars.ticker IN ($6 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.timeframe IN ($7 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.what_to_show IN ($8 /*, ... */) AND price_bars.bar_date <= $9::DATE AND price_bars.close IS NOT NULL) AS anon_1 ON anon_1.price_bar_id = price_bars.id 
WHERE anon_1.date_rank <= $10::INTEGER AND anon_1.source_rank = $11::INTEGER ORDER BY price_bars.ticker, price_bars.bar_date, price_bars.id

SELECT pg_catalog.pg_type.typname AS name, pg_catalog.format_type(pg_catalog.pg_type.typbasetype, pg_catalog.pg_type.typtypmod) AS attype, NOT pg_catalog.pg_type.typnotnull AS nullable, pg_catalog.pg_type.typdefault AS "default", pg_catalog.pg_type_is_visible(pg_catalog.pg_type.oid) AS visible, pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname AS schema, domain_constraints.condefs, domain_constraints.connames, pg_catalog.pg_collation.collname 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_type JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace ON pg_catalog.pg_namespace.oid = pg_catalog.pg_type.typnamespace LEFT OUTER JOIN pg_catalog.pg_collation ON pg_catalog.pg_type.typcollation = pg_catalog.pg_collation.oid LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT pg_catalog.pg_constraint.contypid AS contypid, array_agg(pg_catalog.pg_get_constraintdef(pg_catalog.pg_constraint.oid, $1)) AS condefs, array_agg(CAST(pg_catalog.pg_constraint.conname AS TEXT)) AS connames 
FROM pg_catalog.pg_constraint 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_constraint.contypid != $2::INTEGER GROUP BY pg_catalog.pg_constraint.contypid) AS domain_constraints ON pg_catalog.pg_type.oid = domain_constraints.contypid 
WHERE pg_catalog.pg_type.typtype = $3::VARCHAR ORDER BY pg_catalog.pg_namespace.nspname, pg_catalog.pg_type.typname

current_activity.query:
SELECT datname, numbackends, xact_commit, xact_rollback, blks_read, blks_hit,
                   tup_returned, tup_fetched, tup_inserted, tup_updated, tup_deleted,
                   conflicts, temp_files, temp_bytes, deadlocks, checksum_failures,
                   blk_read_time, blk_write_time, session_time, active_time,
                   idle_in_transaction_time, sessions, sessions_abandoned,
                   sessions_fatal, sessions_killed, stats_reset
            FROM pg_stat_database WHERE datname = current_database()
